## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Udayamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 17) is an early exegetical treatise belonging to the *Cūḷaniddesa* in the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. Titled in English as the "Exposition of the Questions of the Student Udaya", the text provides an extensive canonical commentary and word-by-word explanation on the verses of the *Udayamāṇavapucchā* (Snp 5.14) from the *Pārāyanavagga* of the *Sutta Nipāta* [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records two modern translations of the text in two languages [SuttaCentral].
SuttaCentral identifies passage-level parallels in other Niddesa treatises—the *Purābhedasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 10), *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 16), and *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23)—as well as the Abhidhamma's *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* (Ds 2.1.1), alongside resembling material in the *Kāmasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 1) [SuttaCentral]. Automatically computed text reuse from DharmaNexus corroborates this shared terminology, showing the highest degrees of Pali-internal reuse with the *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 14), *Purābhedasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 10), *Pārāyanānugītigāthāniddesa* (Cnd 22), and *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 16), along with direct textual matches to its root verse text (Snp 5.14), the *Saḷāyatana Saṁyutta* (SN 35), and the *Paṭiccasamuppādavibhaṅga* (Vb 6) [DharmaNexus]. In addition, the underlying verses are cited or paralleled in diverse collections including the Pali Dhammapada (dhp 386), Gāndhārī Dharmapada, Patna Dharmapada, Sanskrit Udānavarga, and Chinese Dharmapada (T 210) [SuttaCentral], with DharmaNexus noting alignments with Sanskrit works such as the *Udānavarga*, *Mahāvyutpatti*, and *Yogācārabhūmi*, and the Chinese *Saṃyuktāgama* (T 99) [DharmaNexus].
